subject: Pilot timeline bump and VPC readout
thread_content:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@finlytics.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 19 Sep 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot timeline bump and VPC readout

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for carving out time on Thursday. Quick recap from our discovery: FinLytics is prioritizing low-latency inference for document understanding (avg. seq len ~512), strict data residency for EU customers, and audit-ready logs for compliance. You mentioned an internal procurement window around late Q4 but didn’t have the final Ops contact confirmed.

Two items I promised after the call: 1) a short VPC/on-prem readiness checklist you can share with your infra team, and 2) a suggested mutual action plan so legal/procurement can see the timeline and milestone owners. I attached both (redwood-vpc-readiness-checklist.pdf, mutual-action-plan.xlsx).

Quick ask: can you confirm who on your side will own the network/infra conversation (name + email) and whether the Q4 procurement window is still the target? If Q4 has shifted I can propose a scaled pilot on dedicated capacity (reserved GPUs) that gives representative latency/cost data without a VPC cutover up front.

If it's helpful I can also pull together a 1-page cost delta (hosted -> dedicated -> private) and an ops playbook for the pilot.

Next steps I recommend:
- You: confirm infra owner and preferred pilot month
- Me: draft pilot SOW + cost delta and share for review

Thanks — appreciate the open conversation.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0119

---

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@finlytics.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Sep 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot timeline bump and VPC readout (bump)

Alex —

Following up on my note from Saturday. I know things move fast; just checking whether Q4 is still the plan or if priorities shifted. If timing slipped, would you be open to a short Dedicated pilot in October to unblock product testing while procurement runs? That path reduces the immediate network work for your infra team and still gives realistic latency/cost numbers.

If helpful, I can: share a 30-day pilot plan, provide an ops checklist for the Dedicated route, and schedule a 30-min sync with Rishi (engineer) and Vanessa (solutions) to answer any questions.

No rush — tell me what works and I’ll align resources.

—Kimberly

---

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@finlytics.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 23 Sep 2026 13:40:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Pilot timeline bump and VPC readout

Hi Kimberly —

Thanks for the follow-up and for the checklist. Appreciate the clear options. Short update from our side: we’ve run into a temporary budget freeze across several product initiatives; until that is resolved I can’t commit to a Q4 procurement window.

That said, the team is still interested in the Dedicated pilot as a lower-effort way to validate performance. Before we proceed I need a high-level cost ballpark (monthly for a small Dedicated pool) and confirmation of what data is captured in logs during the pilot. Also, please confirm whether any customer-facing data will route through Redwood-managed endpoints or if we retain full control inside our VPC for the Dedicated option.

If you can send a short one-pager with cost bands and data-handling guarantees, I’ll pass it to finance and infra. If we can keep this to something short I’ll try to resurface it to leadership next week.

Best,
Alex Turner
Head of ML Platform | FinLytics
alex.turner@finlytics.com | +1 212-555-0199

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 23 Sep 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Pilot timeline bump and VPC readout — FinLytics status (internal)

Team — quick internal note on FinLytics (they are a realistic mid-market opportunity; large docs workload, EU residency concerns):
- Prospect status: paused at procurement due to a cross-org budget freeze but interested in Dedicated pilot as lower-friction path.
- Asks from Alex: 1) one-page cost bands for a small Dedicated pool (monthly), 2) clear data handling guarantees during pilot, 3) confirmation on whether any routing would touch Redwood-managed endpoints for Dedicated.

Proposed immediate actions:
1) Rishi — can you draft a one-pager that includes: sample config (GPU count, p99 latency estimate for 512 seq), monthly cost bands (low/med/high), and a short note on what logs we collect during pilot (audit logs, token-level metrics, no customer PII retained by default). Put the doc in the deal folder and we’ll redline.
2) Vanessa — loop in Solutions or Engineering CS for a 30-min ops Q/A with Alex next week; propose Wed/Thu mornings PT.
3) I’ll add a short note to the HubSpot deal and send Alex the one-pager when it’s ready.

Attachments: internal-pricing-draft.pdf (internal draft — do not share externally yet)

Thanks —
Kimberly
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0119
